description.en: Northern Palestine: 'including areas in modern-day southern Lebanon and the Golan Heights' (Amitai 2017).

sources.quote: In the north was the niyābah or mamlakah – both of which can be translated as “province” in this context – of Ṣafad, including areas in modern-day southern Lebanon and the Golan Heights.

notes.en: Whether the Acre plain (after 1291) and all of Lower Galilee belonged to Safad was not verified.
